IsStackable.rationale: Galvanized.cs:7 `IsStackable => true`. The sim's field matches exactly. Per the sim's own docstring this is currently DORMANT on ported content: GalvanicPower never re-applies through `CardCmd.afflict`'s stacking branch — its own AfterCardEnteredCombat/BeforeCombatStart both gate on `card.affliction is None` first, so no card is ever afflicted twice — it instead syncs the amount directly via a separate write, matching GalvanicPower.cs's own `AfterPowerAmountChanged`-style resync in its sibling VitalSparkPower shape. Ported for fidelity regardless of today's reachability, matching PROMPT.md's own guidance not to skip a field just because it is inert today.

HasExtraCardText.rationale: Galvanized.cs:9 `HasExtraCardText => true` only unlocks the UI `DynamicExtraCardText` LocString (AfflictionModel.cs:44-54) — no sim reader exists or is needed. Same disposition as affliction/bound's HasExtraCardText and enchantment/adroit's precedent.

guards.maps_to: GalvanicPower.BeforeCombatStart (GalvanicPower.cs:34-41) afflicts every Power card in the player's hand/piles at combat start; AfterCardEnteredCombat (:44-49) afflicts a newly-entering unafflicted Power card; AfterCardPlayed (:52-56) deals `base.Amount` damage to the card owner (`ValueProp.Unpowered | ValueProp.Move`) whenever a Galvanized card resolves. GalvanicPower carries no AfterRemoved/AfterSideTurnEnd override at all, so Galvanized afflictions are NOT swept on any timer — they persist on their cards for as long as the card itself exists (see the decay guard below). Mirrored by `power/galvanic` (powers.py), already audited: rollup `gap` — an added `affliction is None` guard at the BeforeCombatStart site (C# has none there, recurring shape 8) and a dropped `ValueProp.Move` flag on the AfterCardPlayed damage — both DORMANT there. Not re-derived here. Applier confirmed ported: `sts2_rl/monsters/glory/globe_head.py`.

Unlike Bound/Entangled/Ringing/Smog, Galvanized has NO turn-boundary sweep at all in either engine — a Galvanized Power card keeps the marker until it is played (which is the affliction's whole point: paying the damage on play) or until some other affliction-clearing event removes it. It is card-scoped to the player's own Power cards (no monster deck exists). No AfterDeath path applies: GalvanicPower is carried by the player, granted by an enemy (Globe Head), with no applier-death removal case.
